source_sentence: In this paper, we discuss some limitations of traditional word analogy evaluation metric in word vector evaluation , and then propose a simple alternative plan called " Analogy Space Evaluation ", which directly measures the relation vectors between given pairs of words , instead of traversing the vocabulary to seek the nearest word of the target.
